label: Forked Tower
tooltip: Forked Tower helpers. Trap spots are South Horn only.

draw_potential_trap_positions.label: Show possible trap spots
draw_potential_trap_positions.tooltip: Draw circles on known trap spawn points inside South Horn Forked Tower.

show_registration_countdown.label: Show registration countdown
show_registration_countdown.tooltip: Show Forked Tower registration / warmup countdown in the Critical Encounters list (North and South Horn).

auto_register_in_illegal_mode.label: Go to the tower when registration opens
auto_register_in_illegal_mode.tooltip: While Illegal Mode is on and Forked Tower registration opens, drop the current trip, travel to the entry pad and wait on it until you are teleported in. Inside, see the option below. Magic (North Horn) is skipped below Knowledge Level 40. Blood (South Horn): you still offer Sanguine Ciphers at a reliquary yourself — BOCCHI only reminds you.

fight_inside_tower.label: Fight inside the tower like a CE
fight_inside_tower.tooltip: When Illegal Mode is on inside the Forked Tower, keep it on and treat the tower as one long CE: BOCCHI's BossMod CE preset handles targeting and dodging and your combat rotation keeps running. Travel, Return, buff refreshes and phantom job swaps are paused, and raises are still accepted. Normal farming resumes once you leave the tower. Off: Illegal Mode turns off when you enter.

navigate_inside_tower.label: Walk with the group inside the tower
navigate_inside_tower.tooltip: Illegal Mode only, out of combat: follow your party members, or the largest group of other players if you have no party, and use the teleport sigils they took. Never uses the exit to base camp. In combat, BossMod moves you as usual. Test feature.

follow_start_distance.label: Start following when the group is farther than (yalms)
follow_start_distance.tooltip: Out of combat, start walking toward the group once it is farther away than this.

follow_stop_distance.label: Stop following within (yalms)
follow_stop_distance.tooltip: Stop walking once the group is this close. Kept below the start distance, so you don't keep starting and stopping.

open_coffers_inside_tower.label: Open coffers inside the tower
open_coffers_inside_tower.tooltip: Illegal Mode only, out of combat: walk to unopened coffers nearby (silver first) and open them. Coffers in the tower are personal loot. Hidden bronze coffers are only opened once something has revealed them.

use_tower_route.label: Walk the recorded tower route
use_tower_route.tooltip: Illegal Mode, out of combat: walk the route through the tower room by room (built-in route, plus any you record) instead of chasing the crowd. Waits for the group when it is behind, follows it when it is ahead, and walks on to the room's pad once the group has gone through. Falls back to following the crowd off the route.

record_tower_mechanics.label: Record tower mechanics to a file
record_tower_mechanics.tooltip: While you are inside the Forked Tower, write enemy actions, map effects, VFX and HP losses to a file in the plugin config folder (forked_tower_records). Used to work out the laser timing; turn it off if the files get too large.

record_tower_route.label: Record my route through the tower
record_tower_route.tooltip: With Illegal Mode off, the path you walk inside the Forked Tower is recorded room by room and saved to forked_tower_routes in the plugin config folder when you leave the tower. Pause briefly at each pad. Recorded routes are used together with the built-in one.
